products.name: DataVision Pro
products.description: AI-powered data visualization platform with automated insights and natural language queries

faqs.question: What data sources does DataVision Pro support?
faqs.answer: DataVision Pro supports 200+ connectors including SQL databases, cloud warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), SaaS applications (Salesforce, HubSpot), and file formats (CSV, Excel, JSON).

faqs.question: Is coding required to use DataVision Pro?
faqs.answer: No coding is required for basic usage. The natural language interface allows users to ask questions in plain English. Advanced users can optionally use SQL or Python for custom transformations.

faqs.question: What is the pricing model?
faqs.answer: DataVision Pro offers tiered pricing: Starter ($99/mo), Professional ($299/mo), and Enterprise (custom). All plans include a 14-day free trial.

products.name: PredictAI
products.description: Machine learning platform for predictive analytics without requiring data science expertise

faqs.question: Do I need a data scientist to use PredictAI?
faqs.answer: No. PredictAI automates the entire ML pipeline from data preprocessing to model selection and hyperparameter tuning. Domain experts can build production-ready models without ML expertise.

faqs.question: What types of predictions can I make?
faqs.answer: PredictAI supports regression (numerical forecasting), classification (categorical prediction), and time-series forecasting. Common use cases include demand forecasting, churn prediction, and fraud detection.

series.name: Collaboration Tools
series.description: AI-enhanced tools for team collaboration and knowledge sharing

products.name: TeamInsight
products.description: AI-powered team analytics dashboard that tracks collaboration patterns and provides optimization recommendations

faqs.question: How does TeamInsight protect employee privacy?
faqs.answer: TeamInsight uses aggregated, anonymized data. Individual activity is never exposed to managers. Insights are provided at team level only, with minimum team size requirements (5+ members).

faqs.question: What metrics does TeamInsight track?
faqs.answer: TeamInsight tracks collaboration patterns (meeting time, focus time, response times), work distribution, and team health indicators. It does not track individual productivity or content.
